# k3d_registry (Data Source)

Reads an existing k3d registry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "k3d_registry" "cache" {
  name = "cache"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Registry name, without the `k3d-` prefix.

### Read-Only

- `host_ip` (String) Host IP the registry is bound to.
- `id` (String) The registry name.
- `image` (String) Registry image.
- `networks` (List of String) Docker networks the registry is connected to.
- `node_name` (String) Name of the registry container.
- `port` (Number) Port on the Docker host.
- `ref` (String) Reference for `k3d_cluster.registries.use`.
